scope: Exact mathematical qualification of prior ENERGY-DELAY-07 NEW/NULL 3-lag false-action-effect rate. No empirical data, new seeds, native learner or original-model primary replay.
hypothesis: Because all three lag outcomes share exogenous nuisance U, their false alarms are correlated. The exact FWER of the frozen max-of-3 smoothed action contrast will lie strictly between previous marginal/union bounds (12.920102%-38.7603066%); its risk far exceeds the nominal 5%. A conventional Fisher/Bonferroni control remains <=5% under a randomized sharp null.
model: 24 episodes, each with A~Bernoulli(1/2), U~Bernoulli(1/2) independent. Conditional on U, the three per-episode lag outcomes independently draw Bernoulli(4/5) if U=1 and Bernoulli(1/5) if U=0. Across episodes independent. Outcome proxy Z irrelevant to intervention contrast. No causal effect under NEW/NULL. A0/A1 counts random. This exactly matches the declared marginal/lag-dependence structure of frozen prior source, not the concrete outcomes of consumed seeds.
enumeration: Enumerate n0=0..24, u0=0..n0, u1=0..24-n0. Each assignment/U profile weight C(24,n0) C(n0,u0) C(n1,u1) / 4^24. Given n_a,u_a, the single-lag success-count polynomial (1+4z)^u (4+z)^(n-u) / 5^n, action arms conditionally independent; across 3 lags conditionally independent given nuisance profile. For each latent profile compute exact probability that the frozen |Beta(0.5) action effect|>=0.30 at one lag, then conditional three-lag FWER 1-(1-p)^3. For the control use two-sided exact Fisher p<=1/60 and the same conditional computation. Sum over latent profiles with BigInt rational arithmetic.
exact_comparison: With n1=24-n0, smoothed posterior action contrast D=(x1+.5)/(n1+1) - (x0+.5)/(n0+1); reject if 5*abs((2x1+1)*(n0+1)-(2x0+1)*(n1+1))>=3*(n0+1)*(n1+1). Fisher sums hypergeometric tables with mass <= observed, rejects if 60*sumTail <= C(24,x0+x1).
denominator: 4^24 * 5^72 for the exact 3-lag unconditional risk; one-lag 4^24 * 5^24; exact prior marginal numerators can simplify by 5^24.
